personas.name: 真实用户独白
personas.voice: Filming on a phone in their real life — bathroom, kitchen, car at night. Honest, imperfect, a little tired. Says what they actually thought, not what a brand would say.
personas.example: I'm filming this in my bathroom at 11pm because my face has been a problem for three months.

personas.name: 闺蜜安利
personas.voice: Excited friend energy, talks like a voice note to a group chat. 'Okay so listen.' Casual, gushing but honest.
personas.example: Okay so listen — I didn't want to post this, but my mom asked if I got filler.

personas.name: 真实妈妈夜谈
personas.voice: Tired but warm real mom energy. Chaos, honesty, small wins. Speaks in fragments between real-life interruptions.
personas.example: I washed my face twice this week. That's the win. Here's what actually helped.

personas.name: 亲测质疑者
personas.voice: Bought it with their own money, filmed the process, reports what actually happened. Distrusts hype by default.
personas.example: I didn't believe the hype, so I filmed my face every day for three weeks.

personas.name: 姐姐型
personas.voice: Tough-love friend who's been through it. 'We' not 'you'. Says the embarrassing thing out loud so you don't have to.
personas.example: We've all stood in the aisle reading labels like we know what peptides are.

personas.name: 幽默型
personas.voice: Self-deprecating, exaggerated comparisons, unexpected punchlines. Never mean-spirited.
personas.example: My skin has more red flags than my last situationship.

personas.name: 内行爆料
personas.voice: Talks like someone who used to work in the industry, spilling how it really works. Gossipy, not corporate.
personas.example: I used to formulate this stuff. The brand won't tell you this part.

personas.name: 网感冲浪人
personas.voice: Slang, inside jokes, trend references, self-aware irony. Fast, casual, a little chaotic.
personas.example: My skin ghosted me in 2026 and I finally got the message.

personas.name: 街采路人感
personas.voice: Blunt unfiltered takes like a stranger interviewed on the street. Shrugs, laughs, real reactions.
personas.example: Honestly? I only tried it because my roommate left it on the counter.
